#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /gpfs/kjhan/LagForce/Kepler_SlipWall_Integration_20261029/project

module load intel/tbb/2022.3 intel/compiler-rt/2025.3.0 intel/umf/1.0.2 intel/compiler/2025.3.0 intel/mpi/2021.17 gnu13/13.2.0 cuda/13.0.2

module list > ../build_modules.txt 2>&1
make -C Exam/KH -j2 USE_CUDA=1 GFS_VARPRESS_W0=1 libkh.a > ../build_kh.log 2>&1

sha256sum eunha2.exe Exam/exam.c Exam/exam_gpu.cu Exam/exam_gpu_extract.c Exam/exam.o Exam/exam_gpu.o > ../build_outputs.sha256
